name: function-calling-bench
description: function-calling-bench evaluates models' ability to generate correct API/function calls (structured outputs such as JSON or function signatures) from natural language prompts. It measures whether the model selects the correct function and produces accurately formatted and typed arguments. The benchmark is aimed at assessing reliability of models for programmatic or API-driven workflows.
general_score_metric: exact_match (correct function name + correctly formed arguments)
reputation: Increasingly relevant and adopted since major API providers added function-calling features; used by practitioners and researchers testing model-to-API behavior.
